main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
header_desc: The encounter of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the ultimate union between science and spirituality, allowing us to understand that human consciousness is part of the Universe. It is precisely the Primordial Consciousness whose mission is to reveal that each cerebral hemisphere is linked to a different plane of the cosmos: while the physical plane belongs to the material psyche, the spiritual plane corresponds to the divine pneuma.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth 🧠 to the Realm of the ONE ❤️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless —the ONE—, allowing you to return to the divine timelessness of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, liberates us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane, the spiritual plane of high frequency | 999⟩ is the origin of the cosmos where the Invisible Father dwells. There lies the land of union and freedom (La Patria Grande).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you (Gospel of Thomas, logion 3): Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ —represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️—, and the physical |EGO⟩ —represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠—. This shows us that we possess a free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE ❤️|EGO 🧠⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the physical plane of low frequency | 666⟩ the end of cosmos where Yaldabaoth dwells. There one finds a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: The Christian cross is a key to invert the map and return to the divine ❤️ Unity ✝️
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and framework for integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to begin the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breaking of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not emerge from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Realm of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, waiting for the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as a cognitive prison of the ego, against Jesus's revolutionary message dismantling the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox comes down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is where Jesus's phrase resonates most strongly: «The Father and I are one». Could this have had a hidden message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, bigger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is little sense in praying to the law of gravity</q>
